counted_on: WorldLayout.build() (the generator behind world/*.rbxmx), same rules as tests/WorldBudget.spec; triangles from shared/modeling-kit/out/<mesh>.fbx

rationale.mesh_slots: THEME.md 'MeshParts per map <= 400' and WorldLayout.MESH_SLOT_BUDGET = 400 (PR #56). Counts MeshAsset + BorderMesh slots + WorldProps skins: each becomes one MeshPart.
rationale.parts: THEME.md / CONTRACT section 10 'decor <= 1200 parts' and WorldLayout.PART_BUDGET = 1200, Part nodes outside Map.Border.
rationale.border_parts: WorldLayout.BORDER_PART_BUDGET = 700 (the border ring's walls, invisible slots and primitive stand-ins).
rationale.world_triangles: Proposed (no existing world limit). 400 mesh slots x 1250 tris (midpoint of THEME.md's 500-2000 per-prop target) = 500k. That keeps a full map under the ~0.5M-triangle scene size low-end phones handle without streaming tricks, and leaves ~28% headroom over today's ~391k.
rationale.max_triangles_per_mesh: THEME.md: the kit fails a mesh at >= 10,000 tris (Roblox's hard upload limit is 20,000). The hero fountain (~6.8k) is the largest today.

_note: selftest fixture: world triangle limit under the current ~391k
